system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> Why can't I find <USER> latest release #ImNotRacist It's cool, we all make mistakes but please be sure to correct this Asap Rocky. <URL>"

EARLIER TURNS:
- <USER> <USER> <USER> I really need this track for a shared playlist. <URL>

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> Hey! We’d love to have all of their stuff available, but we have some info about content here: <URL>"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply is vague and lacks empathy; needs clarity and a more helpful tone."}
